task: Fix the exact parent-closure CI Edit-Time context mismatches by verifying committed metadata-phase proof identity separately from the pre-closure final-main implementation proof, without relaxing any gate.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live closure CI #9204 on exact closure HEAD ad52d8cae737b19ab09980e3b294f93e84a012c4 fails Edit-Time for missing explicit ephemeral artifact environment path and false final-main comparison against the metadata closure commit. The parent completion receipt already binds the proven final main 0c53e9f0baa825e9e1ac8cc9c918527a32ce22f6. Preserve the pre-closure checks, verify the committed closure evidence and first-parent identity, and keep fail-closed execution.
observableOutcomes: Closure metadata CI deterministically discovers only the exact committed parent artifact path from canonical parentClosureContext and verifies identical committed bytes, content digest and context.
A metadata closure commit is accepted only when its exact first parent and declared transaction base equal the independently proved finalMainSha, while the closure HEAD remains separately verified.
Pre-closure proof still requires the explicit artifact path and HEAD equal finalMainSha, without any fallback or downgraded decision.
Malicious or stale artifact, wrong closure parent, missing pre-closure environment and mismatched closed plan continue to BLOCK.
Unchanged U01-U03 receipts, immutable source and canonical release-state remain authoritative and unmodified.
unresolvedRisks: GitHub workflow_dispatch and pull_request contexts can expose different event commit identities; both must bind the exact closure HEAD.
Checking only local working-tree bytes could allow uncommitted artifact substitution; read the artifact blob committed at the exact HEAD as well.
Completion Truth may reveal a separate downstream blocker after Edit-Time; do not claim parent closed until all gates and post-merge receipts pass.

in: Keep current parent closure artifact builder and finalMain receipt identities unchanged.
Teach Edit-Time to distinguish a pre-closure proof executed on final main from a persisted CLOSED metadata-only closure commit.
Require the CLOSED closure HEAD to be a single-parent commit whose parent equals the exact parentClosureContext.finalMainSha and plan.changeBaseSha.

Only in CLOSED metadata verification derive the expected path from canonical context when the ephemeral proof path environment is absent; compare committed artifact bytes and digest against the deterministic builder.
Keep the pre-closure path environment mandatory and validate both modes against a forged or stale proof.
Add targeted regression coverage for valid and invalid phase-identity and proof-artifact conditions.
out: No gate disabling or thresholds changes; no silent accepted proof path for unclosed plans.
No historic immutable source plan widening, no U01-U03 fixture/receipt mutation, no canonical release-state edit.
No workflow, CI permission, authentication, security, storefront, template, Builder, database or deployment changes.
No claim that a parent receipt alone proves post-merge CI or completed lifecycle.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: A closure CI false negative currently blocks an otherwise independently proven parent completion. Correctness requires strict separation between implementation-final-main and closure-metadata-head identity, deterministic artifact verification, adversarial tests and preservation of full downstream gates.

acceptanceCriteria: The plan-only commit passes canonical Plan Before Code before implementation.
On pre-closure parent proof, absence or wrong SHOPERATION_PARENT_CLOSURE_PROOF_ARTIFACT continues to BLOCK.
On closed metadata PR with known exact final main, the expected deterministic artifact path is read from the plan context without relying on a transient runner environment variable.
Closed metadata verification compares expected proof artifact to committed HEAD blob and filesystem bytes, preventing uncommitted substitution.
Closed metadata HEAD is a direct single-parent child of parentClosureContext.finalMainSha and plan.changeBaseSha exactly equals the proven final main.
Any incorrect committed artifact path, content, digest, parent relationship, final main SHA or unclosed plan environment is rejected.
Existing Plan Before Code, Known Failure Edit-Time, Incremental Replay, Truth and Lifecycle gates remain mandatory.
Parent #1138 or its freshly reprojected successor may merge only with fresh exact-head CI SUCCESS, then final main acceptance and canonical closed receipt are independently checked.
invariants: The immutable source development plan does not change.
The final implementation main is proven once and cannot be rewritten to the closure metadata HEAD.
The metadata closure HEAD must be separately identified and directly descend from proven final main without an intervening non-closure commit.
A committed artifact must be byte-identical to the deterministic receipt-bound expected artifact.
An absent pre-closure artifact environment is always a block, never treated as committed metadata proof.
All existing blocking guards and post-merge acceptance conditions remain in force.

failureModes: Ephemeral proof-artifact path not set in closure CI workflow_dispatch environment.
Closed metadata HEAD compared to independently proven final-main implementation HEAD.
Committed artifact missing or different from local working-tree evidence.
Closure commit has extra parent or an unexpected base.
Forged closed status used to bypass pre-closure artifact checks.
Reprojection changes final main but proof still references old final main.
edgeCases: Pre-closure worktree HEAD exactly finalMainSha and explicit proof path exists.
Closed metadata direct child HEAD has no explicit proof artifact env.
Closed metadata direct child HEAD has explicit correct proof artifact env.
Closed metadata branch first parent differs from asserted final main.
Closed plan has incorrect declared changeBaseSha.
Closed artifact bytes changed without matching deterministic digest.
Unclosed development plan omits env proof artifact.
Metadata closure is a merge commit with two parents.

alternatives.summary: Validate pre-closure and persisted metadata closure identities as two explicit, separately proven phases.
alternatives.reason: Retains exact proof semantics while eliminating CI context false negatives; the committed artifact stays independently byte-verified.

alternatives.summary: Suppress the Edit-Time final-main and artifact path checks globally.
alternatives.reason: This would permit stale, forged or missing proof artifacts and violate fail-closed semantics.

alternatives.summary: Rewrite the immutable source or rebind parent final main to closure HEAD.
alternatives.reason: Erases original implementation authority and would falsify immutable parent completion.

alternatives.summary: Force status SUCCESS or skip known failure/Truth in CI.
alternatives.reason: Would hide rather than correct proof-identity mismatches.

specialistReviews.finding: The current Edit-Time guard conflates implementation HEAD and metadata-only closure HEAD.
specialistReviews.resolution: Model explicit pre-closure and committed-closure modes with exact parent identity and immutable final main.

specialistReviews.finding: Defaulting the artifact path without confirming a committed blob could permit forged local evidence.
specialistReviews.resolution: Infer the path only for canonical CLOSED closure context and verify git HEAD committed blob plus deterministic expected artifact bytes.

specialistReviews.finding: A stale parent relationship can wrongly accept a metadata commit for a different final main.
specialistReviews.resolution: Check the exact single first-parent SHA of closure HEAD against parentClosureContext.finalMainSha and plan.changeBaseSha.

specialistReviews.finding: An old successful parent proof does not authorize a closure PR with failed exact-head CI.
specialistReviews.resolution: Retain fresh closure PR exact-head CI, subsequent main CI and canonical receipt verification.

specialistReviews.finding: The last guard reports two isolated new identities, while #9177 plan projection is already resolved.
specialistReviews.resolution: Address only EDIT_TIME_PARENT_CLOSURE_ARTIFACT_PATH_MISMATCH and EDIT_TIME_PARENT_CLOSURE_FINAL_MAIN_MISMATCH with adversarial regression tests.

challenge.scenario: Global default proof artifact path under every development plan.
challenge.finding: Would allow missing pre-closure proof environment to pass.
challenge.resolution: Permit derived path only for closed canonical metadata proof with exact committed artifact.

challenge.scenario: Compare parent finalMainSha with GitHub closure PR HEAD.
challenge.finding: False negative: the closure commit is metadata-only child of final main.
challenge.resolution: Bind finalMainSha to the exact first parent and declared changeBaseSha, HEAD to the closure proof commit.

challenge.finding: A locally forged artifact could satisfy Edit-Time without being persisted.
challenge.resolution: Require git committed blob bytes at exact closure HEAD as well.

challenge.scenario: Accept any descendant commit of final main.
challenge.finding: Intervening unverified changes would be included in closure proof.
challenge.resolution: Require exact direct single-parent relationship for metadata closure commit.

challenge.scenario: Assume passed Edit-Time proves completed parent closure.
challenge.finding: Downstream Truth, Lifecycle and post-merge evidence may still fail.
challenge.resolution: Retain all gates, exact-head PR/main CI and canonical persistence acceptance.

challenge.scenario: Let GitHub CI infer final main from the closure HEAD in workflow_dispatch.
challenge.finding: Workflow_dispatch SHA represents the closure metadata commit and cannot substitute implementation final main.
challenge.resolution: Use receipt-bound finalMainSha from canonical parentClosureContext and verify the actual HEAD direct-parent identity.

challenge.scenario: Accept a closure commit with altered proof artifact bytes but unchanged parent plan.
challenge.finding: A false success would let a modified persisted artifact claim the original parent completion authority.
challenge.resolution: Compare committed blob, working-tree bytes, parsed artifact and deterministic expected digest exactly.

challenge.scenario: Proceed straight to merge after Edit-Time passes.
challenge.finding: Later Knowledge/Replay/Truth/Lifecycle steps may reveal an independent unhandled blocker.
challenge.resolution: Keep downstream gates mandatory, require full fresh CI success before any merge, and route new failure into Intake.

proofPlan: Commit the new development plan alone and require canonical Plan Before Code PASS before implementation.
Change only the Edit-Time parent closure validation path; retain deterministic artifact generation and receipt semantics.
Require pre-closure HEAD equals final implementation main and require the explicitly supplied artifact path.
Require CLOSED metadata HEAD to be a single-parent child of exactly the plan-bound proven final main.
Require exact artifact content and digest in both modes, and git committed blob bytes for CLOSED metadata mode.
Run targeted regression tests proving genuine metadata closure passes and stale, forged, missing or wrong-parent evidence blocks.
Require Knowledge, Plan, Edit-Time, Incremental Replay, Risk, Quality, TypeScript, Build, Truth and Lifecycle gates to pass on exact new hardening HEAD.
Merge only with exact-head fresh CI SUCCESS and verify the corresponding main CI SUCCESS before immutable rehearsal replay.
Replay the unmodified immutable source and require CI SUCCESS on closure PR, parent lifecycle state and canonical closed receipt.
Preserve Failure Intake for every new reproducible blocker, and never claim completion from isolated green checks.

requirements.requirement: A pre-closure proof and a metadata closure commit must be independently verified against their exact and distinct Git identities while deterministic parent evidence remains committed and receipt-bound.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A missing explicit pre-closure proof artifact environment cannot be silently accepted.
Uncommitted, altered, missing or forged closure proof bytes cannot authorize metadata closure.
A metadata closure commit not directly based on the exact trusted final main cannot pass.

notes: Live observation 2026-10-08: main 0c53e9f0baa825e9e1ac8cc9c918527a32ce22f6 CI #9198 SUCCESS; immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 unchanged; U01/U02/U03 CLOSED; parent #1138 HEAD ad52d8cae737b19ab09980e3b294f93e84a012c4; CI #9204 Edit-Time failed with ARTIFACT_PATH_MISMATCH and FINAL_MAIN_MISMATCH. The old queued Release Unit Execution #182 has main head_branch and its execute job requires a successful source-branch push, so it cannot perform the rehearsal executor mutation. This separate development plan fixes the closure CI phase-identity evidence only; do not edit canonical release-state. Canonical plan-only CI #9207 projected actual scope is DOMAIN-QUALITY, owner quality-knowledge-system, no named impacted subsystem, negativeKnowledge SQ-NK-012, guardDigest aa79c504. These values are derived from Plan Before Code rather than guessed from previous release runtime scope.
